flyer.justification: Meets all format requirements including title length constraints and placeholder rules while capturing key themes accurately.

instagram.justification: Includes hook, carousel cues, appropriate emojis, clear call to action, and exactly 10 targeted hashtags.

linkedin.justification: Avoids forbidden buzzwords and clichés, includes five relevant hashtags, and frames the talk effectively for LinkedIn.

summary.justification: Under 400 words, structured with all required executive briefing sections and markdown formatting.

newsletter.justification: Subject line is under 50 characters, and the email contains three distinct sections with bold subheadings, greeting, and calls to action.

blog.justification: Failed to include a comparison/takeaway table and numbered insight sections as strictly required by the format specifications.
